body.audience_summary: Curious adult beginners who make coffee at home and want more consistent results.

outcomes.statement: Explain the core brewing variables that affect coffee extraction and taste.
outcomes.evidence: Learner explains grind, water, ratio, and time in plain language.

outcomes.statement: Apply a repeatable home brewing workflow to produce a balanced cup.
outcomes.evidence: Learner follows and adjusts a brewing recipe using observable results.

outcomes.statement: Analyze common taste problems and choose an appropriate adjustment.
outcomes.evidence: Learner diagnoses sour, bitter, weak, or muddy coffee scenarios.
